Resolved by this unit. The entry recorded the INT8 hybrid-layout 500 as blocked on a release decision; the defect is now fixed. Root cause: packed_decode_max_rows was assigned the declared direct width before the layer layout was computed and never revisited, so a hybrid INT8/BF16 session advertised width 4 while its BF16-prefix layers have no retained planes. Added _gguf_packed_decode_max_rows in qwen35_gguf_runner.py to cap the width at one row for a hybrid layout, which routes through the existing NotImplementedError refusal that step_batch_native already turns into a serialized fallback. Verified: scripts/int8_mtp_server_lifecycle_gate.py passes 7/7 on the default hybrid layout, and the probe matrix that previously produced four 500s now returns 200 for every case with zero REQUEST_FAILED.
